text:
Late in a pleasant middle, a noisy queue arose while the kennel attendant was handling it. Incident Report: Passenger and Pet Queue Disturbance at the Companion Animal Travel Desk. The line at Aurelia Skyways tightened when several travelers arrived together with carriers, paperwork, and strong concerns about cabin acceptance. The kennel attendant was checking tags and comfort notes when one pet became vocal, another carrier was set down too hard, and nearby travelers began speaking over one another. The senior coordinator moved in at once, separated the active cases, and asked the queue to step back in an orderly way. The welfare coordinator inspected the animal involved and confirmed that the pet remained calm, hydrated, and fit to continue travel under supervision.

The situation escalated briefly because one traveler believed a service change had not been recorded correctly, and the desk became crowded around the counter. Staff spoke in short, clear lines and shifted the affected files to a side station. <<FACT F120>> The senior coordinator checked the ledger, matched the booking notes, and confirmed the service entries already on file. No injury occurred, no kennel damage was found, and no pet showed signs of lasting distress. The delay affected the desk flow and the boarding sequence, so the matter was treated as an operational incident.

Handling steps were taken without hesitation. The queue was split into smaller groups, the loudest exchange was ended, and the travelers were asked to remain behind the marked line. The welfare coordinator stayed with the pet until the noise level dropped. Staff recorded the service change in the desk ledger and informed the travelers of the next steps in a calm and direct manner. <<FACT F109>> The desk then resumed normal processing, with the senior coordinator monitoring the line and the kennel attendant returning to standard handling duties.

Follow-up will include a review of the counter layout, a reminder to staff on crowd control, and a check of the ledger entry for accuracy. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will keep the case on file and watch for any repeat disruption. No further action is needed unless new facts arise.
